name: Bingbang
source:
A story of modern melancholy, a short, nostalgic visual novel about a forgotten ice pop — and the girl who once felt like a big sister to you.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2775540]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一个关于现代忧郁的故事，一部简短的怀旧视觉小说，讲述了一支被遗忘的冰棒——以及一个曾经对你来说像大姐姐的女孩。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2775540]Steam[/url]]
